title: Merry Christmas, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description A red car filled with gifts, snow glistening in the lamplight, and children waiting impatiently for the celebration to begin — this coin takes you straight into a world where the magic of Christmas brings generations together. Inspired by classic holiday postcards, the design reflects the spirit of family moments, simple gestures, and the joy of shared anticipation. It’s a special keepsake that reminds us that sometimes the greatest gift is the feeling these days carry with them.
